### ROI Calculator Framework

```
Monthly Revenue Opportunity:
  Current patients on prevention: [A]
  Total eligible patients: [B]
  Compliance gap: [B - A] = [C]
  Realistic conversion (next 6 months): [C × 15%] = [D]
  Average monthly prevention revenue per patient: $35
  New monthly revenue: [D × $35] = [E]

Monthly Cost:
  Additional inventory cost: [F]
  
Monthly NET Revenue: [E - F] = [G]
Annual NET Revenue: [G × 12]
ROI: [Annual NET Revenue] / [Annual Cost] × 100 = X%
```
